business_problem: TechD needed to help a multi-state lottery and digital gaming client answer high volumes of highly specific player questions quickly and consistently despite changing rules, promotions, and jurisdiction-specific regulations.
solution_summary: TechD built a virtual-agent solution for the gaming and lottery sector on NeuralSeek, IBM watsonx Assistant, and IBM Cloud so player support could move from manual queue handling to AI-driven self-service. NeuralSeek provides the natural-language layer that combines large language models with the operator’s knowledge base, while watsonx Assistant and IBM Cloud support scalable delivery across lottery and online gaming channels. The assistant answers questions about winnings, promotions, state-specific rules, and other rapidly changing details in seconds, and its analytics and real-time response layer help keep answers consistent even as content changes. Sensitive player data is protected across the multi-state environment, and the same platform can assist multiple lotteries and gaming properties without requiring separate support stacks. By reducing first-line workload and giving players immediate, accurate responses around the clock, the solution improves customer experience and protects revenue for the jurisdictions that depend on those gaming operations.

solution_components.name: NeuralSeek
solution_components.role: Provides the natural-language AI layer that combines LLMs with the operator’s knowledge base for player support.

solution_components.name: IBM watsonx Assistant
solution_components.role: Delivers the virtual-agent experience that classifies and answers player inquiries across lotteries and gaming channels.

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts the AI solution and its multi-state support architecture in a scalable environment.

data_flow: Player questions arrive from lotteries and online gaming platforms, NeuralSeek and watsonx Assistant interpret the request against the gaming knowledge base, relevant answers are returned in seconds, and support analytics and protected player data keep the system current across jurisdictions and promotions.
business_outcome: The TechD solution reduced support workload, improved satisfaction, and let the lottery enterprise handle player queries consistently across states and platforms without scaling its human support team at the same rate.
